baseline_models.focus_anchor: 17:97 words 2, 5, 7, 11, and 13: guidance, being guided, being made astray, awliya, and apart from Him.
baseline_models.mechanism: Guidance supplies a gently indicated course; straying loses that course. A wali supplies contiguous proximity and active care, so the failed search for awliya makes orientation depend on a relation that cannot be replaced from below or outside God.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication toward road and truth supplies both the directing act and the guided person's orientation.
Deviation from guidance and intended course supplies the opposed loss of orientation.
Proximity without an intervening gap makes the absent awliya unavailable replacement nearness.
Otherness supplies the excluded domain from which substitute guardians are sought.

changed_reading.before: Guidance and error are opposite divine outcomes, followed by the absence of helpers.
changed_reading.after: The ayah maps guidance as maintained orientation within unbroken divine proximity; being made astray is loss of that orientation, and no substitute proximity or administration can be found outside Him.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: 17:97 words 14 and 18-21: gathering on faces while blind, mute, and deaf.
baseline_models.mechanism: A gathered group is driven toward a destination, but here it travels upon the bodily front that normally faces and navigates toward that destination while sight, speech, and hearing are disabled. The scene somatically enacts movement without guidance.

activation_trace.role: Driving and collecting a group toward a destination supplies coerced collective motion.
Direction and facing supply the body's normal orienting front, here converted into its bearing surface.
Loss of sight removes visual navigation from the driven movement.
Blocked speech removes the capacity to answer or coordinate while being driven.
Loss of hearing and non-reception remove auditory orientation and response.

changed_reading.before: The gathering posture and three disabilities form a list of punishments.
changed_reading.after: They form one anti-guidance mechanism: a collective is moved toward a destination through an inverted bodily front with every ordinary channel of navigation and response disabled.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: 17:97 words 22 and 24-27: their ma'wa is Jahannam; whenever it subsides, blaze is added.
baseline_models.mechanism: A place of gathering and shelter is inverted into fire, and the temporal construction couples every loss of flame to renewed addition. The destination is therefore an actively maintained feedback loop rather than a static enclosure.

activation_trace.role: Joining a place that gathers and shelters supplies the destination function that Jahannam reverses.
Encompassing totality supplies the repeated whenever-condition without an ungoverned remainder.
A flame's subsiding under ash supplies the falling state monitored by the cycle.
Added growth supplies the corrective upward movement after every subsidence.
Kindling and flaming supply the intensity repeatedly restored.

changed_reading.before: Jahannam is a destination whose fire happens to be increased.
changed_reading.after: The false refuge is a self-renewing punitive regime: every incipient cooling becomes the condition for a fresh increment of blaze.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah names recompense, identifies covered signs, and stages the denial of being raised as new creation from fragmented remains. This revises the disabled body of 17:97 into a reconstituted body whose perceptual channels materially answer the prior covering of signs.

activation_trace.role: Blindness of heart and insight supplies the focus-side impairment that can embody covered recognition.
Matching an act with its recompense authorizes reading the bodily condition as a responsive consequence.
Obscuring truth supplies the epistemic covering that the later blindness makes bodily.
Pulverization and debris supply the disintegrated material from which the punished body is imagined impossible.
Rousing what was still from dormancy supplies reactivation of the fragmented body.
New occurrence after severance supplies reconstitution across the break of death and fragmentation.

structural_cues: 17:98 immediately calls the focus fate their recompense and embeds the objection to renewed creation after bones and fragments.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: recompense, covering signs, fragments, arousal, and new creation. Reader arrow: I treat reconstituted but disabled senses as a bodily repayment of covered signs and denied re-creation. Live alternative: the sequence may state cause and capability without feature-by-feature mirroring.

changed_reading.before: Blindness, muteness, and deafness enact anti-orientation during gathering.
changed_reading.after: The anti-oriented body is also a precisely reconstituted answer: those who covered signs and denied renewed embodiment receive embodiment whose channels of recognition are present yet disabled.

context_deltas.mechanism: Seeing is demanded in 17:99; clear signs arrive in 17:101; and 17:102 places knowledge and insight beside Pharaoh's public label of sorcery. The focus blindness therefore sharpens from mere lack of information into the terminal embodiment of recognition resisted and politically redescribed.

activation_trace.role: Blindness of insight anchors the changed reading in the focus sensory condition.
Seeing by eye and insight presents recognition as an available act.
Refusal supplies a volitional barrier after the appeal to see.
Manifest disclosure supplies signs characterized by visibility rather than obscurity.
Diversion and deception supply Pharaoh's counter-label for manifest signs.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the inward recognition asserted beneath the public counter-label.
Insight of the heart supplies the intended function of the descended signs.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from 'do they not see' to clear signs, an accusation of sorcery, and the counterclaim 'you knew' that they descended as insights.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: available seeing, refusal, manifest signs, a deceptive counter-label, asserted knowledge, and insights. Reader arrow: I read the final blindness as resisted recognition becoming condition. Live alternative: the focus disability may be punitive without encoding the earlier psychology of refusal.

changed_reading.before: The blind condition removes perceptual orientation.
changed_reading.after: It consummates a repeated split between available evidence, inward recognition, and outward refusal: a chosen counter-reading of signs hardens into embodied non-seeing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hypothetical human owner of mercy's treasuries would conserve them through fearful constriction. This makes the absent alternative awliya in 17:97 not merely powerless helpers but failed custodians: creaturely possession tends to convert protective administration into withholding.

activation_trace.role: Taking charge of an affair supplies the administrative function expected from the missing awliya.
Possession and disposal supply the hypothetical transfer of mercy's stores to human control.
Securing and preserving stores supplies the custody imagined in the hypothetical.
Tender mercy supplies what protective custody ought to distribute.
Holding wealth back through stinginess turns custody into blocked distribution.
The exit of wealth in expenditure supplies the feared outflow that triggers withholding.
Constriction and reduction characterize the human custodian produced by that fear.

structural_cues: The counterfactual directly links owning mercy's treasuries to withholding from fear of expenditure, then generalizes the constriction to the human being.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: hypothetical ownership, stored mercy, fearful withholding, expenditure, and human constriction. Reader arrow: I treat an alternative wali as a would-be custodian and read 17:100 as exposing why such custody fails. Live alternative: 17:100 may critique avarice without explaining the exclusivity of wilayah.

changed_reading.before: No guardian outside God can restore the person made astray.
changed_reading.after: No creaturely substitute can hold the office reliably: when imagined as owner-custodian of mercy, the human guardian protects the stock from the needy rather than the needy through the stock.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pharaoh tries to unsettle a people out of the land, is drowned with his collected party, while the displaced people are told to dwell and are later brought as an interwoven mass. The focus gathering becomes a spatial reversal of coercive displacement: the would-be expeller loses ground, and divine agency determines both settlement and final reassembly.

activation_trace.role: Driving a collected group toward a destination anchors the focus as coerced collective relocation.
A lightness that shakes stability supplies Pharaoh's attempted uprooting of settled bodies.
Killing by inundation reverses the expeller's control of land into loss beneath water.
Joining dispersed members into one whole supplies the collected party engulfed with Pharaoh.
Dwelling in a home restores settled location to those targeted for expulsion.
Bringing something into presence supplies the promised divine counter-movement and final arrival.
Mixed elements wrapping into one group supply a densely reassembled collective rather than a scattered population.

structural_cues: The actor-patient sequence runs from Pharaoh's attempted removal, through his party's drowning, to the other's settlement and God's later collective bringing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: destabilization from land, drowning together, restored dwelling, promised arrival, and an interwoven group. Reader arrow: I read these as a reversal pattern that specifies the force of 'We gather them.' Live alternative: the historical reversal and final gathering may remain parallel events rather than one spatial mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus gathering is a generic forced procession at resurrection.
changed_reading.after: It is the terminal form of a repeated sovereignty over placement: attempted human expulsion is overturned, dwelling is reassigned, and scattered bodies are finally brought together under divine rather than imperial direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Truth is delivered by descent, then the recitation is differentiated and addressed to people over deliberate pauses. This supplies an operative architecture for the gentle direction in 17:97: guidance is not only a verdict but truth made traversable through staged arrival, distinction, reading, and time.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication toward road and truth anchors the context sequence as a possible means of guidance.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the content both carried down and arriving.
Causing something to descend and reach its recipient supplies directed delivery of truth.
Reading and recitation supply the repeatable human access point to the delivered truth.
Distribution into parts supplies staged rather than undifferentiated delivery.
Deliberate unhurriedness supplies the temporal cadence by which the parts become traversable.

structural_cues: 17:105 repeats truth with descent, and 17:106 links differentiated recitation to addressing people over a measured interval before repeating descent emphatically.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: true descent, recitation, differentiation, and unhurried duration. Reader arrow: I treat that delivery sequence as the concrete mediation of divine guidance in 17:97. Live alternative: the verses may describe revelation's form without specifying how individual guidance occurs.

changed_reading.before: God guides a person onto a true course.
changed_reading.after: The course is provisioned in time: truth descends, is articulated into distinguishable portions, and is recited at a pace through which a person can be gently oriented.

context_deltas.mechanism: Both groups descend bodily, but the knowledgeable fall voluntarily on chins in prostration, remain able to speak and weep, and receive an increase of humility. The focus group is forced onto faces without sight, speech, or hearing and receives increased blaze. Posture alone does not distinguish guidance; responsive reception and the object of increase do.

activation_trace.role: The face as bodily front anchors the coerced downward orientation of the focus group.
Blocked speech marks the focus descent as nonresponsive.
Loss of hearing marks the focus descent as unreceptive.
Growth by addition supplies the shared operator whose object is blaze in the focus.
A sounding, unsettled fall supplies the responsive group's bodily descent.
The meeting of the jaws supplies the precise front edge on which the responsive group falls.
Lowering in submission gives the fall a voluntary relational direction.
Voiced utterance contrasts the speakers with the focus group's blocked speech.
Tears, grief, and voice show sensory-affective responsiveness during the repeated fall.
The same increase operator now intensifies an inward disposition rather than external flame.
Lowering and submission supply the beneficial object of increase.

structural_cues: 17:107-109 repeats falling on chins and surrounds it with recitation, speech, tears, and increased humility; 17:97 places bodies on faces amid sensory blockage and increased blaze.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: two downward bodily postures, opposed response capacities, and two uses of increase. Reader arrow: I pair them as controlled contrasts and make the increased object diagnostic of the descent. Live alternative: prostration and punishment may be neighboring images without deliberate one-to-one opposition.

changed_reading.before: Being gathered on faces is simply humiliating transport, followed separately by increased fire.
changed_reading.after: The focus is one side of a paired descent: guided lowering stays receptive and increases humility, while coerced lowering closes reception and transfers increase from the inner posture to the surrounding blaze.

context_deltas.mechanism: Invocation is directed between audible declaration and vanishing speech, and that middle is explicitly sought as a path. Against the focus muteness and deafness, guidance becomes calibrated communicability: neither maximal volume nor acoustic extinction, but a viable channel between them.

activation_trace.role: An affair's direction, manner, and intended course anchor the middle voice as a form of guided conduct.
Blocked utterance supplies one failed endpoint against which a viable vocal path is sought.
Non-hearing supplies failed reception at the other side of communication.
Calling and inclining another through speech supply the relational act whose channel is regulated.
Public declaration and raised voice supply the high-volume endpoint.
Voice becoming still and speech ceasing supply the low endpoint approaching inaudibility.
Active seeking turns the median channel into a pursued practice rather than an automatic compromise.
A state intermediate between two ends supplies the calibrated middle.
An extended traversable road makes vocal calibration itself a path.

structural_cues: The prohibitions establish two vocal endpoints, while the imperative joins seeking, between, and path into one construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: invocation, raised voice, extinguished voice, an intermediate state, and a sought path. Reader arrow: I read vocal calibration as a local enactment of guidance and the focus disabilities as loss of the whole channel. Live alternative: the prayer instruction may regulate etiquette without commenting on eschatological muteness or deafness.

changed_reading.before: The focus sensory losses signify inability to communicate and receive.
changed_reading.after: They are the collapse of a calibrated path: guided address sustains a transmissible middle between overpowering declaration and vanished speech, whereas the punished body can neither send nor receive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing ayah denies God a partner in sovereignty and a wali arising from abasement, then commands magnification. Read back into 17:97, the plural search for awliya is exposed as creaturely dependency projected outward: humans need protective administration under vulnerability, while divine wilayah is not reciprocal dependence.

activation_trace.role: Protective alliance and support supply what the astray seek in plural outside God.
Sovereignty supplies the undivided domain in which no co-administrator is required.
Participation supplies the denied sharing of sovereignty.
Protective support supplies the kind of wali explicitly denied as a divine need.
Broken subjection under force supplies the vulnerability from which a dependent protector would be needed.
Majesty and greatness replace the dependency model with divine asymmetry.

structural_cues: The closing negations coordinate offspring, partnership in sovereignty, and a protector from abasement before the doubled command to magnify God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: no partner in sovereignty, no protective wali caused by abasement, and magnification. Reader arrow: I use that negation to distinguish God's active guardianship from the creature's dependent need for guardians. Live alternative: the two wali clauses may share vocabulary without defining a single asymmetrical relation.

changed_reading.before: Those made astray cannot find protectors other than God.
changed_reading.after: Their search reveals the direction of dependence: vulnerable creatures seek plural protection, but the only effective wali neither shares sovereignty nor receives protection from vulnerability.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The supported, swaying gait is a branch-distant image rather than a gloss of guidance here. It remains anchored in the focus h-d-y inventory and becomes mechanically relevant beside driven movement on faces; downstream prose should present it only as a bodily analogy for sustained orientation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The two h-d-y forms at words 2 and 5 stand before the gathering on faces at words 14 and 18.

activation_trace.role: Walking while leaning on two supports supplies a material image of orientation maintained through supported gait.
Driven collective movement supplies the later counter-motion that lacks self-directed gait.
The bodily front becoming a bearing surface turns the counter-motion into an inversion of upright supported travel.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is cognitive or directional indication.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, guidance also admits the material image of a gait held upright by supports, while punishment drives an unsupported body on the very front by which it would orient.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This depends on the packet's non-dominant z-y-d to z-w-d mapping and must not replace the ordinary increase sense. It remains anchored to word 26 and coheres with ma'wa and blaze as a destination system; render it as an inverted travel-provision resonance, not lexical equivalence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Words 22, 26, and 27 couple destination, addition, and blaze.

activation_trace.role: Joining a gathering place supplies the terminus toward which provision would normally support travel.
Carrying provisions for transfer supplies the form-distant image of what is repeatedly furnished for the punitive passage.
Kindled flame supplies the horrific substance functioning as the added provision.

changed_reading.before: Every decrease in flame is countered by a quantitative increase.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, each increment also resembles forced provisioning for an ongoing transfer: the travelers are furnished not for safe arrival but with the blaze that sustains their punitive destination.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The prayer-to-fire link uses a form-distant s-l-w branch and a cross-domain control analogy, so it is not a claim that prayer denotes fire here. It remains anchored in the focus subsiding/increasing blaze and in 17:110's explicit vocal endpoints and middle; downstream prose should mark it as a speculative structural resonance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus couples subsidence to renewed blaze; 17:110 regulates prayer between loudness and disappearance.

activation_trace.role: Flame subsidence supplies the low thermal endpoint that the punitive loop refuses to retain.
Added growth supplies the upward correction applied whenever the flame falls.
Kindling supplies the high thermal state repeatedly restored.
Meeting fire and its heat supplies the branch-backed thermal resonance inside the prayer term.
Raised declaration supplies the excessive vocal endpoint.
Voice extinction supplies the vanishing vocal endpoint.
An intermediate state supplies the regulated median available to prayer but absent from the fire cycle.

changed_reading.before: The fire is maintained by a one-directional feedback loop.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is an anti-median regulator: prayer seeks a sustainable band between vocal blaze and extinction, whereas punishment converts every approach to extinction into renewed blaze.

strongest_changes: The disabled body becomes reconstituted recompense for covering and knowingly refusing signs, not merely an arbitrary list of impairments.
The paired scenes of 17:97 and 17:107-109 distinguish coerced and responsive descent through speech, hearing, tears, and whether increase takes humility or blaze as its object.
Truth's descent, differentiation, recitation, and measured pacing give the focus guidance a concrete temporal delivery mechanism.
The final denial of a wali from abasement makes divine guardianship asymmetrical rather than one instance of reciprocal protection.
summary.what_was_special: The tightest activation came from repeated operators and bodily fronts: gathering versus falling, faces versus chins, blocked response versus speech and tears, and increase of blaze versus increase of humility. Split mappings also exposed contained material analogies of supported gait, forced provision, and thermal regulation.
remaining_uncertainties: The recompense-as-sensory-mirroring arrow is coherent but not explicitly stated feature by feature.
The custody reading from 17:100 depends on treating an alternative wali as a distributor of mercy, which may be a thematic rather than syntactic link.
The supported-gait, provision, and prayer-fire outliers rely on branch-distant or non-dominant mappings and should remain exploratory.
